content: Consumer lag on the orders topic comes from a slow partition: partition 7 owns the hot merchant key. Fix is to add a salt to the partition key for that merchant.
Kafka consumer: commit offsets only after the batch is written to postgres, otherwise a crash loses messages. Use idempotent upserts keyed by event_id.
psql -h db -c "\copy staging_postings FROM 'postings.csv' CSV HEADER"

The PySpark to postgres upsert was slow because row-by-row inserts hit the WAL for every row. Bulk load with COPY into an UNLOGGED staging table, then one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT into the target. Runtime went from 3 hours to 13 minutes.
gcloud transfer jobs create gs://exports gs://archive --include-prefixes=tables/postings/
Reading a news article about football transfers

Rolling back a bad kubernetes deployment: check kubectl rollout history, then kubectl rollout undo to the last good revision, then confirm with kubectl rollout status. Open an incident if error rate stays above 1%.
Heads up: helm values for the payments namespace now pin the image digest, so rollback via helm rollback works too. Ping me at bob@example.com if it fails.
